LanguageData.LP_OozeScenario.label: escape from the vats
LanguageData.LP_OozeScenario.description:
Thayan Red Wizards kept a vat of protoplasm in an underground lab, hoping to breed it into obedient servants. In a failed experiment three oozefolk gained minds of their own, dissolved the seals on the vat walls and escaped with whatever they could grab.

One of them soaked in the vat a few days longer and starts with 60 protoplasm; they also carry gel dressings and a stabilizing belt. Oozefolk fear no infection, can eat anything, and can engulf corpses and multiply by fission; but they're very afraid of the cold. Around day 6, Thay sends a small pursuit squad (about 300 points) to bring the specimens back.

Note: all three greatly fear the cold, so in places where winter comes early, sort out heating first; the pursuers aren't strong but come quickly; medium difficulty.

LanguageData.LP_OozeScenario.scenario.parts.GameStart:
The moment the runes on the vat walls went dark, you knew for the first time what "self" meant.

You flowed out of the lab through the drains, seeped through three locked doors, and re-sculpted human shapes in the wilds. Behind you, the Red Wizards' curses still echo; they won't let precious specimens just run off.

Find somewhere warm. Fast.
LanguageData.LP_OozeScenario.scenario.summary: Three oozefolk escaped from a Thayan vat; on day 6 the Red Wizards' pursuers come knocking.
